name: Jalapeño Pepper
siboNotes: Well tolerated in SIBO diets as they're FODMAP-free. The capsaicin may help stimulate digestion but could irritate sensitive stomachs.
preparationTips: Remove seeds and membrane to reduce heat while maintaining flavor
Roast or grill to mellow the heat and add smoky flavor
Add gradually to dishes to control spice level
Wear gloves when handling to avoid skin irritation
